                                                 our MWE Gold V2 PSU.

                                                 Plus Gold efficiency certification, long-lasting double ball bearing

                                                 Japanese capacitors, and a 10-year warranty.
                                                 Each of these features comes together to provide users with the

and insects.

for universal compatibility with current-
gen motherboards.
